pages.name: Business Website Development and Redesign
pages.title: Business Website Development Philippines | J0hnvexcoder
pages.description: Business website development and redesign for companies in the Philippines. Responsive service pages, project galleries and clear contact paths by J0hnvexcoder.
pages.summary: I build responsive company websites and redesign existing sites around clear services, useful content and an accessible contact path.
pages.problem: A business website should help someone understand the company and decide what to do next. Missing information, unclear navigation or difficult mobile layouts can get in the way. A redesign starts by examining what is already useful, what needs correction and which existing pages should be retained.
pages.solution: I build responsive business websites that make it easier for customers to understand your services, explore your work and contact you. The agreed scope can include company pages, products or menus, galleries and location information. Basic SEO setup and deployment readiness are planned alongside the interface; the number of pages follows the content you need to explain.
scope: Company, service, product or menu presentation
Responsive layouts, galleries and contact/location information
Page titles, descriptions, headings and basic indexability setup
Performance review and agreed deployment/domain assistance
pages.distinctSection: Redesigning an existing site: inventory the current content and URLs, retain useful material, clarify the new structure, and plan any necessary redirects before launch. The implementation follows the access and platform available; a migration is scoped separately when it requires substantial changes.
faq: Can you improve an existing website?
Yes. The starting point is an inventory of the current site, its content and the access available. The agreed work may be a focused improvement or a broader redesign.
Does this include online payments?
Only when an actual payment and order workflow is agreed. Existing storefront demonstrations do not establish that a live payment system is already integrated.
pages.evidence: ARKOSENYO and TAITECH Marine are confirmed client projects with published website demonstrations. Donut House is a fictional storefront. The case studies distinguish implemented interfaces from unverified delivery integrations.

pages.name: Technical SEO and Website Optimization
pages.title: Technical SEO Services Philippines | J0hnvexcoder
pages.description: Technical SEO services for websites in the Philippines: audits, metadata, crawlability, canonical URLs, structured data and practical performance improvements.
pages.summary: I review how your website is discovered and loaded, then address crawlability, metadata and performance issues backed by actual findings.
pages.problem: A visually complete website can still have missing metadata, confusing canonical URLs, broken links or pages search engines cannot reliably discover. Slow assets and mobile usability issues can also make the same content harder for people to use.
pages.solution: My technical SEO work starts with the published website and the access available. I review how pages are structured, discovered and loaded, then prioritize demonstrated issues with titles, headings, internal links, canonical URLs, indexing directives or structured data. Performance work follows the same approach: measure the relevant pages and address the causes within the agreed scope.
scope: Search-intent and keyword-to-page review for agreed priority pages
Metadata, headings, alt text, internal links and canonical review
Crawlability, sitemap, robots, redirects and status-code diagnostics
PageSpeed/Core Web Vitals review and practical fixes within available access
Search Console monitoring and agreed reports when access is provided
pages.distinctSection: Verification matters: use the production build and crawlable HTML to check what is actually published. Repeatable before/after checks are more useful than a promised score. Search rankings, traffic and leads are not guaranteed; content, competition and search systems also affect results.
pages.portfolioEvidence: This portfolio's static export, metadata, canonical, internal-link and structured-data checks provide a concrete implementation example. They are not evidence of ranking gains or a client SEO campaign.
faq: Is SEO included in a new website?
Basic setup belongs in the agreed build scope. A deeper audit, recurring monitoring or substantial remediation is defined separately.
Do you guarantee rankings?
No. The service provides scoped technical work and transparent findings, not a guaranteed position, traffic increase or sales result.
pages.evidence: This portfolio provides an inspectable example: page metadata, canonical URLs, crawlable case-study links and structured data. It does not establish a ranking gain or a client campaign result.

pages.name: Custom CMS Development
pages.title: Custom CMS Development Philippines | J0hnvexcoder
pages.description: Custom CMS development for businesses in the Philippines. Tailored content editing, admin dashboards and separately scoped catalog or record-management tools.
pages.summary: I build content editing and administration tools around the pages, images and records your business needs to manage.
pages.problem: When every small content update requires a developer, a website can become difficult to maintain. A product catalog or request workflow needs more than an editable text field: the team needs clear records, permissions and publishing controls.
pages.solution: I develop content management tools that let your business update agreed website text, images and relevant SEO fields without editing code. The administration interface follows what you need to manage and who is allowed to change it. Product catalogs, request records, publishing approvals and notifications are separate capabilities to define before development.
scope: Agreed administrator access and content/media controls
Database-backed text, images and relevant SEO fields
Optional product/service catalogs with publishing controls
Optional request records, references, statuses, attachments and notifications
pages.distinctSection: The administration model is scoped before the interface: who can edit, what needs review, which records are retained and what integrations are necessary. The CMS extends a website or application; it does not make unrelated business processes automatic by default.
faq: Can my team update the site without editing code?
Yes, for the content and controls included in the agreed CMS scope. Some design or functionality changes still require development.
Does every project need a custom CMS?
No. A simpler content platform or source-managed site may be sufficient. The choice follows the editorial workflow and long-term maintenance needs.
pages.evidence: MovieFlix and Nexora demonstrate administration and data-management patterns in different applications. They are not completed client website CMS deployments.

pages.name: Professional Portfolio Website Development
pages.title: Portfolio Website Development Philippines | J0hnvexcoder
pages.description: Professional portfolio website development in the Philippines. Present your experience, projects and achievements through an original, responsive personal website.
pages.summary: I create professional portfolio websites that connect your experience, projects and achievements with a clear way to contact you.
pages.problem: A résumé provides a summary, but projects often need context, images and explanation. A portfolio should make that evidence easy to inspect without forcing every person into the same visual template.
pages.solution: I create professional portfolio websites that bring your experience, projects and achievements into one clear presentation. Each site is designed around your work, rather than forcing it into a generic template. Where the evidence supports it, individual project pages explain the challenge, development choices and implemented result. The visual direction stays grounded in readable content and mobile usability.
scope: Professional identity, experience and relevant qualifications
Selected work and evidence-backed case studies
Responsive layout, accessible contact options and sharing metadata
Agreed visual direction, animation and interaction depth
pages.distinctSection: The visual treatment should follow the work. A highly animated creative portfolio and a concise professional profile serve different visitors. Content, imagery, permissions and interaction requirements are agreed before the design expands.
pages.portfolioEvidence: J0hnvexcoder's own portfolio demonstrates a more interactive personal presentation; it is distinct from the two professional portfolio examples.
faq: Can the design be original rather than a template?
Yes. The agreed visual direction can be custom, with interaction and content shaped around your work.
Do I need all my projects on the homepage?
No. A focused selection can lead into individual case studies, with supporting work organized in an archive.
pages.evidence: Jenica Salazar’s Portfolio and Mark Jaron’s Portfolio are confirmed client projects, published with permission. The case studies explain the delivered presentation and each contact workflow; career outcomes are not inferred.

pages.name: Booking and Reservation Systems
pages.title: Booking System Development Philippines | J0hnvexcoder
pages.description: Booking system development for Philippine businesses, from reservation requests to separately scoped availability, confirmation and administration workflows.
pages.summary: I develop reservation-request or booking workflows around your availability, confirmation and administration requirements.
pages.problem: Collecting a preferred date is different from reserving an available slot. A booking workflow needs a clear owner for availability, confirmation, cancellations and changes; otherwise the website can create expectations the business cannot fulfill.
pages.solution: For a request-based website, customers provide the required details and preferences, then the business reviews and confirms manually. An operational platform can instead maintain a booking calendar, agreed inventory or capacity, administration controls and automated confirmations. The appropriate model is defined before development.
scope: Structured request details and date/service preferences
Manual confirmation workflows where appropriate
Separately scoped real-time availability and booking calendars
Agreed room/slot/service inventory and administration
Notifications, changes and cancellation rules when included
pages.distinctSection: Before building, define what is reservable, who can change availability, when a request becomes a confirmed booking and which existing systems must connect. Payments, third-party calendars and complex operational rules are separate requirements to establish, not assumed integrations.
faq: Is a reservation request a confirmed booking?
Not automatically. A request-based workflow waits for the business's manual confirmation. The interface must communicate that distinction.
Can you build real-time availability?
It is an available separately scoped platform requirement. Inventory, staff controls and confirmation rules must be agreed and validated before it is described as operational.
pages.evidence: TAITECH Marine’s client request preview demonstrates conditional form design. It is not an operational booking engine: submission, live availability and confirmed reservations require separate implementation.

pages.name: Custom Web Applications and Business Solutions
pages.title: Custom Web Applications Philippines | J0hnvexcoder
pages.description: Custom web application development in the Philippines for agreed workflows, dashboards, integrations and interactive experiences. Scope and feasibility come first.
pages.summary: I build focused web applications for specific workflows, data and interactions, with feasibility and support agreed before development.
pages.problem: Some projects need to connect information, guide a multi-step task or expose an interaction that a conventional content page cannot provide. The useful starting point is the task itself, including who uses it and how success is verified.
pages.solution: I develop custom web applications around the task your business needs to complete. That may involve a dashboard, integration, records workflow or interactive product presentation. I define the users, data, permissions and expected behavior before selecting technologies. A frontend prototype and an operational application remain different deliverables, with different acceptance checks.
scope: Workflow discovery and clearly scoped application behavior
Agreed dashboards, records, integrations and access controls
Focused automation or custom software where appropriate
Interactive 3D or product presentation when it serves the experience
Validation and deployment/maintenance planning appropriate to the system
pages.distinctSection: I agree on scope, feasibility, delivery timeline and support requirements before development. A dashboard, file-processing tool and interactive 3D experience need different architectures and acceptance checks. A prototype is only described as operational after its required integrations are implemented and tested.
faq: Can a prototype become an operational application?
Potentially, after the backend, integrations, permissions and operational requirements are defined and implemented. A working interface alone is not enough.
How is the scope decided?
By reviewing the intended users, workflow, existing systems, necessary integrations and a clear acceptance plan before development.
pages.evidence: These examples span tools, release-candidate infrastructure work and frontend demonstrations. Each case study identifies what is implemented and what has not been exercised in a live operating environment.

care.name: Website Care and Maintenance
care.copy: After launch, I can help with agreed content updates, reported defects, broken links and configuration troubleshooting. Website Care supports the delivered website; monitoring, response arrangements and new features are defined separately.
care.boundary: Care coverage and response arrangements are agreed for the selected service. New features, redesigns, booking platforms and recurring SEO work are scoped separately.
